points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Can you tell the customer messages from the agent messages at a glance, by side or colour?
Do mixed lines with 5G, eSIM or TX-48213 keep each English word whole and in place?
Does each message show its time, and is the time readable?
Are the six messages in order, oldest at the top and newest at the bottom?
Are the text field and the send button both at the bottom of the screen?
Is the send button easy to recognise?
Is the spacing even and the page tidy, with nothing cramped, overlapping or out of line?
